newsitem.title: JAPAN: KDD to launch domestic service for corporate users.
newsitem.headline: KDD to launch domestic service for corporate users.

text.p: Kokusai Denshin Denwa Co Ltd (KDD) said on Wednesday it will launch a domestic service for corporate users on July 26.

KDD director Hideo Katsube told a news conference the company will offer a domestic and international combined service for its "Route KDD" corporate users. The fees for long-distance rates for these users would be 51 percent lower than those of Nippon Telegraph and Telephone Corp (NTT), he said.
KDD at present has 2,700 users of the Route KDD service, Katsube said.

He also said KDD will start offering high-speed digital leased line services in 14 areas of Japan from July 26. For the Tokyo, Nagoya and Osaka areas, the rate for most of the services would be about 20 percent lower than those of NTT, he said.

Users of KDD's 1,500 public phones will also be able to make international and domestic calls using an IC card from July 26. KDD plans to increase the number of such public phones to 2,200 by March 1998, he said.
It will start domestic long-distance services for individual users from early 1998.
